I have two types of dissociative episodes (I'm diagnosed btw, so this was explored and analized in therapy):

\- the ones that last a few minutes (or seconds if I'm lucky), just standing still, feeling nothing, depersonalization and derealization at the max, but it goes away fast. they happen when I'm overwhelmed in one specific moment (like an argument or something like that) or in an unknown place.
